For the Petitioner : Mr. Kripa Shankar Nanda, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto,
A.P.P.
-----
Order No.03 Date: 14.08.2024
1.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Basia P.S. Case No.44 of 2023 registered under Sections 385/170/419/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

As per the allegation,
co-accused Abhishek told the informant (driver of the truck bearing registration no.MP-13H-1291,
which was apprehended due to overloading) that he with the help of the petitioner who was working in the District Transport Office, Gumla, would get the said truck released.
In fact, the petitioner is not at all involved in the alleged occurrence.

Except the alleged disclosure of co-accused Abhishek,
there is no cogent material to connect the petitioner with the alleged offence.
Though the petitioner is posted as Road Safety Manager in the District Transport Office, Gumla, however, he is not concerned with any issue relating to checking of the overloaded vehicles.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedent as has been stated in paragraph no.12 of the present anticipatory bail Prabhash Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ..........

1 application.
He also undertakes to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, he may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P. opposes the petitioner's prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named,
in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Gumla in connection with Basia P.S. Case No.44 of 2023 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas/Arpit Prabhash Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .......... Opp. ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103515579/
